title: Six-byte record capacity growth
summary: Recover the 32-bit vector capacity growth calculation at 0x5a9680, including wrapped address differences and the original unsigned overflow guard.
test_description: Compare the original thiscall routine and recovered member on small, boundary, wrapped and deterministic varied address differences and requested counts; check all object words and the installed FS head remain unchanged.
known_limits: The object fields are represented as 32-bit address words to preserve x86 subtraction semantics; the containing type and record meaning are not identified.
Only the capacity calculation is recovered; allocation and insertion performed by the caller are outside scope.
